adjudication.rationale: The migration `20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` backfills with raw SQL: `INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)` using `h` from the old `site_settings.embeddable_hosts` value verbatim. This bypasses `EmbeddableHost`’s `before_validation` normalization (`sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` and trimming paths) and even bypasses the model format validation. As a result, legacy entries like `http://discourse.org` (previously handled by `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` stripping scheme during comparison) can be stored as `http://discourse.org`. Later, `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` parses the request URL and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, so `uri.host`=`discourse.org` will not match a DB row `http://discourse.org`, causing `host_allowed?` to return false and `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` to raise `InvalidAccess`.
